verdict: Yes. Sattuz from Madhubani pitched sattu-based superfood drinks and snacks on Shark Tank India Season 1, but didn't get a deal. Sattu is a traditional Bihari protein food with a growing national audience.
angle: Sattu is high in protein and cheap, and popular in Bihar and eastern UP. Ready-to-mix drinks and snacks bring it to new buyers. A regional story helps.
